definitions.gloss: Instagram-worthy; looks good on social media
definitions.explanation: something that is visually appealing and suitable for posting on social media to attract attention and likes

examples.japanese: SNS{映|ば}え⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}る→撮る：00760_toru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦カフェ→カフェ：06767_kafe⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧SNS{映|ば}え⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦スイーツ→スイーツ：27370_suiitsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。
examples.english: This cafe is famous for its Instagram-worthy sweets.

examples.japanese: SNS{映|ば}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{意識|いしき}した→意識する：17974_ishikisuru⟧⟦メニュー→メニュー：11166_menyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Menus designed for social media appeal are increasing.

notes:
⟦{映|ば}え→映え：25470_bae⟧ (from ⟦{映|は}える→映える：02393_haeru⟧, "to look attractive") became a suffix meaning "looks good on ~" with ⟦インスタ→インスタ：28008_insuta⟧⟦{映|ば}え→映え：25470_bae⟧, the winning buzzword of 2017; SNS{映|ば}え is the more general version. On its own, ⟦{映|ば}え→映え：25470_bae⟧ is also a casual noun: ⟦{映|ば}え→映え：25470_bae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{狙|ねら}う→狙う：00313_nerau⟧ (to go for the look).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦インスタ→インスタ：28008_insuta⟧⟦{映|ば}え→映え：25470_bae⟧: the original, specifically about Instagram
- ⟦{写真映|しゃしんば}え→写真映え：19246_shashinbae⟧: looks good in photos, without the social-media angle

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- SNS{映|ば}えする: to look great on social media
- SNS{映|ば}え⟦スポット→スポット：11578_supotto⟧: a spot popular for social-media photos
- SNS{映|ば}え⟦{狙|ねら}い→狙い：00312_nerai⟧: aiming for social-media appeal
